label: Забыть
description: A 10-sentence conjugation card for забыть (to forget).

missions.phrase: Я никогда не забуду этот день.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Perfective future, first-person. 'Забуду' is the я-form of perfective забыть, built on the stem забуд-, and carries future meaning. The imperfective partner is забывать.
Strategic focus: Perfective future, second-person. 'Забудешь' takes the -ешь ending on stem забуд-. As a perfective, it marks a single future moment of forgetting.
Strategic focus: Perfective future, third-person singular. 'Забудет' is the он-form ending in -ет. 'Про встречу' names what he will forget about.
Strategic focus: Perfective future, first-person plural. 'Забудем' shows the мы-form ending -ем on stem забуд-. The negation stresses lasting gratitude.
Strategic focus: Perfective future, third-person plural. 'Забудут' is the они-form with the -ут ending. Being perfective, it points to a completed act of forgetting.

missions.phrase: Я опять забыл свои ключи дома.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Masculine past tense. 'Забыл' is the masculine singular past of perfective забыть. 'Опять' adds the everyday flavour of forgetting the keys again.
Strategic focus: Feminine past tense. 'Забыла' adds the feminine -а ending. It reports a single completed act of leaving the umbrella behind.

missions.phrase: Дети забыли свои тетради в классе.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Plural past tense. 'Забыли' is the plural past form ending in -и. It states that the whole group forgot their notebooks.
Strategic focus: Singular imperative. 'Забудь' is the informal command of perfective забыть, here negated to mean don't forget. The negated perfective imperative warns about a specific task.
Strategic focus: Modal infinitive use. 'Хочу' governs the bare infinitive 'забыть', the perfective form. The sentence expresses a wish to put all the bad things behind.
